# Bench cat audio

“Meow.ogg” — Dan Crosby (Dcrosby), recording of his cat Silas, 29 October 2006.

Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Meow.ogg

License: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported:
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/

The original 0.8-second Ogg recording is included unchanged as `cat-meow.ogg`.
Playback volume is lowered in the game. The cat model is original procedural art.
